_about: Sample questions so the quiz works end to end. Have your instructor check every question, and aim for about 10 per stage. answer is the index of the right choice, counting from 0. stage must match an id in stages.json, or be "general".

questions.question: In what year was José Rizal born in Calamba, Laguna?
Who was Rizal's mother, and his first teacher?
questions.explain: His mother, Teodora Alonso Realonda, taught him to read and pray.

questions.question: At which school in Manila did Rizal earn his Bachelor of Arts in 1877?
choices: Colegio de San Juan de Letran
questions.explain: He graduated from the Ateneo Municipal with highest honors.

questions.question: Rizal dedicated El Filibusterismo to which three martyred priests?
questions.explain: Fathers Gómez, Burgos and Zamora were executed in 1872.

questions.question: Where in Madrid did Rizal earn his licentiate in medicine?
questions.explain: He finished medicine at the Universidad Central de Madrid in 1884.

questions.question: What was the newspaper of the Propaganda Movement that Rizal wrote for?
questions.explain: La Solidaridad was the Propaganda Movement's newspaper in Spain.

questions.question: In Paris, Rizal trained under which famous eye doctor?
questions.explain: He worked at Dr. Louis de Wecker's eye clinic; Otto Becker was in Heidelberg.

questions.question: Rizal published an annotated edition of whose 1609 history of the Philippines in Paris in 1890?
questions.explain: He annotated Morga's Sucesos de las Islas Filipinas.

questions.question: In what city was Noli Me Tangere first printed in 1887?
questions.explain: The Noli was printed in Berlin. El Filibusterismo was printed in Ghent.

questions.question: Which friend lent Rizal the money to print Noli Me Tangere?
questions.explain: Dr. Máximo Viola paid for the printing. Valentin Ventura later helped with El Filibusterismo.

questions.question: Rizal's exile in Dapitan began in what year?
questions.explain: He was exiled to Dapitan in July 1892.

questions.question: Who lived with Rizal during his exile in Dapitan?
questions.explain: Josephine Bracken came to Dapitan in 1895.

questions.question: What does "Noli Me Tangere" mean?
questions.explain: It is Latin for "touch me not".

questions.question: In what year was Rizal executed at Bagumbayan?
